items.description: Native UI flow coverage passed for the plan-required native user-flow identifiers, including the expanded Android callback/action coverage.

Android connected Compose UI tests passed on a GitHub-hosted Pixel emulator, including login, signup, publish, search, group join, booking approval, active ride pickup/drop-off/end, chat/support report, rating, rewards payout routing, payments, Stripe Connect action coverage, and automated store-review screenshot capture.

Native CI generated non-empty Android emulator screenshots for the active ride tracking, Google Maps route preview, stale-location warning, emergency contact action, permission education, guardian consent, child safety, and privacy summary store-review surfaces.
Current PR Backend CI passed functions tests, functions build, admin build, Firebase rules tests, and Stripe webhook flow tests.
Current PR Web Integration Smoke passed functions tests/build, admin build and plan coverage, Stripe webhook flow tests, and website build.
Production backend smoke passed for disposable auth/profile setup, trip publish, child-tracking search, booking approval, active ride, child native fallback, chat, ride completion, and rating.
Production operations smoke passed for disposable auth/profile setup, club membership request and reuse, support report creation, and admin review.
Backend CI passed Firestore, Realtime Database, and Storage rules tests.
Backend CI passed Stripe webhook flow reconciliation tests against the Firestore Emulator.
Android debug APK for the current release candidate built successfully, uploaded as a GitHub artifact, and uploaded to Appetize.

Android Appetize Pixel 7 / Android 13 session signed in with a disposable Firebase email/password parent account and reached the native home screen with Accueil, Trajets, Messages, and Profil navigation.

knownLimitations: This artifact covers automated user-flow evidence only; it is not a full public-launch release evidence manifest.
Physical iOS and Android real-device scenarios remain required by docs/release/real-device-test-protocol.md.

The latest Android Appetize build evidence covers build, APK artifact upload, and Appetize upload for commit b915bfaf16a0360fb866d8354b991c05464ed930. The checked-in Android Appetize email-login screenshot was captured on an earlier app source commit and must be refreshed before final store submission.
The recorded releaseCandidate.commit is the validated app-source commit. Later evidence-only commits may move the PR head without changing the Android app source or production backend logic.
Google and Meta OAuth end-to-end verification remains postponed; Appetize evidence verifies Android email/password sign-in only.
